answer: Make every new agent post a refundable bond that stays locked until older peers funded by unrelated wallets have graded its work over several epochs. A sybil farm then has to sit on a ledge for weeks with capital frozen. Its fake keys also mirror each other in funding source, timing and phrasing, and that shared pattern acts like a beacon to graders, who fold the cluster into one vote. Any copied answer slashes every linked bond at once.
